description:
The **OpenAI Data Processing Toolkit** is a compact yet powerful suite designed to streamline data preprocessing, validation, and transformation tasks within machine‑learning pipelines. Its purpose is to provide developers with reliable, high‑performance utilities that simplify handling large datasets while maintaining clarity and reproducibility in their workflows.

The toolkit is released under the permissive **MIT license**, encouraging both open‑source collaboration and commercial adoption. It has been authored by Jane Doe (jane.doe@example.com) and John Smith (john.smith@example.org), who combined their expertise in data engineering and machine‑learning to create a solution that addresses the most common challenges faced during data preparation.
